{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cyborrean battlemount''' was a beast of burden native to [[Cyborrea/Legends|Cyborrea]] used for military purposes. At the [[Second Battle of Vontor]] during the [[Xim Wars]] of [[25,100 BBY]], [[Jilruan/Legends|Jilruan]] mercenaries in the service of the [[Hutt Empire]] mounted on Cyborrean battlemounts decisively defeated the [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].
